title_hint: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
summary_hint:
Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

texts.bleepingcomputer:https://www.bleepingcom:
CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are now exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild. [...]
Cisco Expressway Series Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root.
This vulnerability is due to the use of persistent cookies. Additionally, there is insufficient validation of client certificates when the TLS Verify Mode is set to Enabled for clustering, which means that client certificates are not validated. An attacker with possession of the cookies could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to the database service and invoking specific remote procedure call (RPC) commands. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.
Note: Cisco Expressway Series refers to Cisco Expressway Core (Expressway-C) devices and Cisco Expressway Edge (Expressway-E) devices.
Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. There are no workarounds that address this vulnerability.
This advisory is available at the following link:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-vcs-static-cred-hr7EWZ8t
This advisory is part of a group of advisories. For a complete list of the advisories and links to them, see Cisco Advance Notification for Publication of October 21, 2026, Security Advisories. In addition, for further documentation of improvements and fixes in Cisco Expressway Series see Cisco Expressway Series Security Hardening Release: October 2026.
Security Impact Rating: Critical
CVE: CVE-2026-76466

en.title: Cisco Expressway Series: RCE via database service
en.summary: A critical remote code execution vulnerability in Cisco Expressway Series allows unauthenticated, remote attackers with persistent cookies and network access to execute root commands.
en.impact: Unauthenticated, remote attackers with persistent cookies and network access can execute arbitrary operating system commands as root on clustered Cisco Expressway-C and Expressway-E devices.
en.fix: Upgrade to fixed software release `X15.5.20` or later, or migrate from versions `X14 and earlier`.
checks: Inventory Cisco Expressway-C and Expressway-E devices to identify running software versions.
Verify if devices are configured in a cluster.
Check network exposure and access controls for database services on Expressway devices.
Apply the software updates provided by Cisco to remediate CVE-2026-76466.

ru.title: Cisco Expressway Series: RCE через службу базы данных
ru.summary: Критическая уязвимость удаленного выполнения кода в Cisco Expressway Series позволяет неаутентифицированным удаленным злоумышленникам выполнять команды с правами root.
ru.impact: Неаутентифицированные удаленные злоумышленники, обладающие постоянными файлами cookie и сетевым доступом, могут выполнять произвольные команды ОС с правами root на кластеризованных устройствах Cisco Expressway-C и Expressway-E.
ru.fix: Обновите ПО до исправленной версии `X15.5.20` или новее, либо мигрируйте с версий `X14 and earlier`.
checks: Инвентаризируйте устройства Cisco Expressway-C и Expressway-E для определения используемых версий программного обеспечения.
Проверьте, настроены ли устройства в кластер.
Проверьте сетевую доступность и средства контроля доступа к службам базы данных на устройствах Expressway.
Примените обновления программного обеспечения, предоставленные Cisco для устранения CVE-2026-76466.

de.title: Cisco Expressway Series: RCE über Datenbankdienst
de.summary: Eine kritische Remotecodeausführungsschwachstelle in der Cisco Expressway Series ermöglicht nicht authentifizierten Angreifern die Ausführung von Root-Befehlen.
de.impact: Nicht authentifizierte, remote Angreifer mit persistenten Cookies und Netzwerkzugriff können beliebige Betriebssystembefehle als root auf geclusterten Cisco Expressway-C- und Expressway-E-Geräten ausführen.
de.fix: Aktualisieren Sie auf die korrigierte Software-Version `X15.5.20` oder neuer bzw. migrieren Sie von den Versionen `X14 and earlier`.
checks: Erfassen Sie alle Cisco Expressway-C- und Expressway-E-Geräte, um die laufenden Softwareversionen zu ermitteln.
Überprüfen Sie, ob die Geräte in einem Cluster konfiguriert sind.
Prüfen Sie die Netzexposition und Zugriffskontrollen für die Datenbankdienste auf Expressway-Geräten.
Wenden Sie die von Cisco bereitgestellten Software-Updates zur Behebung von CVE-2026-76466 an.
